new_results.statement: In a globally sign-balanced pair-PSD positive-diagonal chamber, with F=uu^T-A and s3(A)>=s, either max_i sum_j F_ij^2>=s^2/4 or some disjoint original-coordinate cut S,T has e2(F_ST^T F_ST)>=s^4/32.
For rank-two F0 with s2=c, s3(uv^T-F0)>=dist(u,col F0)dist(v,row F0)c^2/(||u||||v||+||F0||)^2; perturbation subtracts ||E||op.

For one hub, A_LL=D+uu^T, A_Lh=u0u-b, Delta=||u||^2||b||^2-(u.b)^2, and augmented Theorem-MF row leverages<=1/2, the full ambient density is continuous and ||p_Q||inf<=3*2^(4/3) Delta^(-1/3). Exact-rank-three pure stars with three abs eigenvalues>=s satisfy <=7.559526299369239/s.

predecessor_application: On the prior three-bank counterexample, each physical defect row has energy O(1/m), but its bank-compressed defect has e2=1565001/2500=626.0004, so the new theorem necessarily detects fixed collective CROSS-2VOL for large m.

partner_application.actual_inequality: For a fixed-scale sign-frustrated pair-PSD triangle with diagonals>=m and all pair defects<1/16, ||p_Q||inf<=6sqrt(pi)/[m(sqrt(15)/2-1)]=11.355918489042871/m<4pi/m; a defect>=1/16 is paid by the definite pair bound 4pi/m.

remaining_gap: QFORM-BALANCED-DEFECT-RECEIVER-v1: pay the STAR/CROSS-2VOL alternatives universally, handling high augmented leverage and collective e2 spread over many individually small singular directions without losing product provenance.
